page.layout: Two parallel columns of Hebrew lexicon entries, the left column of 26 lines and the right column of 14 entries, both under the page number at the head. No notes in the margins, no footnotes.

main_text.l: ירה projicere, לירוא? (pro לירוה) לירוה? ad projiciendum, Infin. Kal,
ירוץ confringetur, malus fiet, fut. Niph. 3. f. m.

page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied as closely as the scan allows; the heavily inked Hebrew words, the pointing and the vowel marks in lines of the left column (especially the forms after "projicere" and "ad projiciendum") are doubtful and marked [?] where they could not be read with certainty. The header letters at the top are Hebrew resh (ר) in both columns. The right column begins mid-entry with "9. pro", which continues from the left column's entries. Some right-column lines were read as separate entries; the printed numbering 9 and the spacing indicate that the first right-column line begins a new numbered entry. The page is a digitised print with dark specks and ink smudges, which are not printed text.
